summary: Completed one full-stack pass on public URL with backend pytest + live API checks + frontend desktop/mobile smoke. Core requirement-alignment checks mostly passed on UI (model-approval text, route families, redirects, overflow) but critical backend production-route failures and one frontend runtime crash were found.

critical.issue: Returns 500 Internal Server Error. Backend log shows ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'backend' raised from services/wizard/objective_compile.py import path during production.validate_definition.
Returns 404 'No training run with that reference is on your board' so whitepaper handoff from requested historical run cannot execute via board action.

minor.issue: Intermittent/operational 409 Watch suspension ('commissioning capability is suspended ...'). This caused flaky create-run tests in combined rerun.
Auth hardening observation: after 6 failed logins there was no lockout (6x401, next correct login still 200).
CORS response observed as Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *; app-level httpOnly auth cookie was not observed in login response (Cloudflare cookie present only).

ui_bugs.issue: Route /os/build/yourmodels triggers React runtime crash: 'Objects are not valid as a React child (found: object with keys {registry_id, weight_sha256})'.

integration_issues.issue: Signed-out correctly shows backend refusal ('Request refused (status 401). Prior view preserved.'). Signed-in correctly shows honest empty state; no false successful empty store while signed-out.

action_items: Fix training production import path in services/wizard/objective_compile.py so /production/runs/{id}/definition does not crash (ModuleNotFoundError backend.*).
Implement/restore board-action white_paper support for requested historical run m9j-9a46b862f339 (or provide explicit supported handoff path with parity).
Fix /os/build/yourmodels rendering by normalizing model fields before rendering (do not render objects directly).
Stabilize test/ops handling for Watch suspension 409 on board/new (deterministic skip or explicit precondition check in test suites).
If auth lockout/cookie/CORS hardening is required by product policy, implement explicit lockout and credentialed CORS policy; otherwise document this as accepted behavior.
critical_code_review_comments: Runtime import defect: production.validate_definition relies on services.wizard.objective_compile which imports backend.contracts.*; this module path is unresolved in deployed runtime and causes 500.
Whitepaper path mismatch: board action is strictly board-run keyed, but requested historical training run id is not present in board index; current API cannot satisfy requested handoff path.
OwnerDeferredWorkspace maps yourModelsView.origin from m.base object; downstream render path treats it as React child string and crashes page.

success_rate.backend: 83% (29/35 in combined rerun; major failing slice is production-route + whitepaper path)
success_rate.frontend: 90% (core load/routes/overflow/dap auth behavior passed; one critical yourmodels crash)

seed_data_creation: None. Only temporary board runs were attempted; cleanup delete was executed where creation succeeded.

rca of the issue: (1) Production-definition 500 reproduces with: login operator -> POST /api/training/lab/board/new -> POST /api/training/lab/production/runs/{shape}/definition. Backend stacktrace points to bad absolute import (`from backend.contracts...`) in objective_compile chain.
